name: cdm/legaldocumentation/master/MasterAgreementClause
description: Defines clauses that make up a Master Agreement

counterparty.description: Optional counterparty role. This can be used where a clause needs to be assigned to a specific party on the agreement based upon their role i.e. Party A or Party B.

otherParty.description: Optional party. This can be required for umbrella agreements where a clause may need to be assigned to a specific party who may or may not be on the agreement.

variant.description: Allows multiple variants to be defined for a clause. This needs to be an array as some clauses can specify different variants for different parties. At least one variant must be specified for a clause.
